name: Lamb
source:
A little humanoid (kemonomimi) lamb who found a wolf in the woods and asked him for help to pick some flowers and deliver some goods to her grandmother.
[spoiler]Later it is revealed she is a demon from hell who finds plasure in reaping her victims from their memories, deceiving/manipulating them and then killing them over and over again.[/spoiler]
